title: A lazy Polars query, in order
prompt: Arrange the lines into a lazy query that reads a folder of Parquet files, keeps readings since `start`, averages temperature per sensor, sorts by sensor, and only then runs. One block would read everything eagerly and doesn't belong.
hints: A lazy query starts from a scan, chains the transformations, and ends with the call that executes it.
`scan_parquet` builds a plan without reading anything; `read_parquet` loads every row and column immediately. Filter before you group, so less data reaches the aggregation.
scan → filter → group_by → agg → sort → collect, inside the parentheses.
